baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two negated verbs flank the socially loaded noun صَاحِبُكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: ض ل ل supplies departure from a route or aim, while غ و ي supplies corrupt orientation within dark falsehood; ص ح ب makes the audience's sustained acquaintance the evidentiary frame. The paired negation therefore tests two failures rather than repeating one denial.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance or aim supplies the route-level failure being denied.
Sustained association makes long observation by the addressees part of the claim's warrant.
Dark confusion and immersion in falsehood supply the distinct orientation-level failure being denied.

changed_reading.before: A flat assertion that the companion is not mistaken.
changed_reading.after: The long-known companion has neither left a right course nor adopted the corrupt orientation that would make his course false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ ... غَوَىٰ can be read through loss, carrying accompaniment, and a spoiled result.
baseline_models.mechanism: A custody model coexists with wayfinding: something may be lost from possession or retention, carried along in accompaniment, and arrive in a failed or spoiled condition. Both losses are negated of the companion, though the focus ayah leaves the carried object implicit.

activation_trace.role: Losing or failing to locate something supplies failure of custody.
Loss of retention supplies the narrower possibility that entrusted content slips from memory.
Taking or carrying something along turns companionship into a possible transport relation.
Failure and a ruined condition supply corruption at the outcome rather than loss en route.

changed_reading.before: He neither wandered nor made an error.
changed_reading.after: The companion neither lost what he bore nor let its condition fail between custody and delivery.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صَاحِبُكُمْ stands between a root image of an ownerless stray and a second root's images of deprivation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship counters abandonment: the subject is not an unclaimed stray in a place of loss, and protective accompaniment remains a live shade of the relational noun. This makes non-deviation partly a claim about preserved relation, not isolated self-direction.

activation_trace.role: The ownerless stray in a wasteland supplies abandonment as a concrete form of being lost.
Protective keeping through accompaniment supplies preservation against abandonment.
Lonely deprivation supplies the failed condition from which accompaniment preserves the subject.

changed_reading.before: The subject independently kept himself on course.
changed_reading.after: The one still identified by companionship was neither abandoned into tracklessness nor left to a desolating condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive كُمْ marks social belonging, while a branch of غ و ي concerns collective cooperation in wrong.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can distinguish relation from capture: he remains 'your companion' without being absorbed into a coalition gathered around wrongful purpose. The first negation denies individual loss of course; the second can faintly deny social recruitment into corrupt alignment.

activation_trace.role: Departure from aim supplies individual course failure.
Close social association keeps the subject inside the addressees' known relational world.
Gathering in wrongful hostility supplies collective capture as an exploratory second failure.

changed_reading.before: Companionship implies agreement with the surrounding group.
changed_reading.after: He remains socially yours without sharing either your route error or a possible collective alignment around it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding image joins a conspicuous celestial marker to downward motion. It supplies a counterexample in which descent remains marked and directed, revising ضلال from any unusual movement into loss of aim and preserving غي as a different, inward corruption.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from aim is the focus failure contrasted with directed descent.
Darkly corrupt orientation remains distinct from merely moving downward.
A prominent marker or item of knowledge supplies orientation during the motion.
Falling into downward space supplies motion that need not itself equal misguidance.

structural_cues: The oath's marked descent occurs immediately before the paired denial and shares its final cadence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prominent marker and a fall; I infer that marked descent can remain oriented and use it to separate motion from error. A live alternative is that the oath is only solemn framing with no diagnostic relation to the two verbs.

changed_reading.before: Any departure from ordinary position might look like wandering.
changed_reading.after: Unusual or descending motion is not the issue: the denied failures are loss of aim and corrupt inward orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech is placed against personal inclination and then identified with secretly imparted knowledge. That sequence supplies the previously implicit cargo in the custody baseline: the companion's utterance carries received content rather than losing it in memory or spoiling it through appetite.

activation_trace.role: Loss of retention supplies one possible channel failure now explicitly constrained by the context.
Carrying something in accompaniment supplies the transmission channel.
Immersion in falsehood supplies corruption of the delivered content.
Articulated speech identifies the output whose integrity is at issue.
Personal inclination supplies the competing source explicitly excluded from the utterance.
Knowledge cast in secrecy supplies the incoming content that the companion conveys.

structural_cues: Two negative clauses about the companion are followed by a negative exception structure contrasting speech-source alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, excluded inclination, and hidden imparting; I infer a source-to-speaker-to-utterance channel and treat loss or corruption as its failure modes. The alternative is a narrower claim only about the origin of this utterance, not the companion's broader reliability.

changed_reading.before: The verse defends a generally sensible person.
changed_reading.after: It defends a transmission channel: received knowledge is neither dropped in custody nor recast by the speaker's appetite.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and attained integrity lead into agreement between inward heart and outward sight, capped by an eye that does not swerve. The focus negations expand into a calibrated witness system: acquisition, retention, inward appraisal, and visual attention converge rather than failing at different stages.

activation_trace.role: Loss of retention supplies a possible failure between instruction and report.
Darkly mistaken appraisal supplies an inward failure distinct from visual drift.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the acquisition stage.
Integrity and completion in the self supply calibration rather than mere force.
Contradiction of truth supplies the failure explicitly denied of the heart.
The heart as inward heat supplies the intense interior register that agrees with perception.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the observed input tested by the heart.
The eye's lateral drift or fatigue supplies a perceptual analogue of route deviation.
Direct eyesight locates the calibration claim in embodied perception.

structural_cues: The later paired negation ما زاغ البصر وما طغى formally echoes the focus ayah's ما ... وما ... pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies instruction, inner non-falsification, seeing, and a second paired denial about sight; I infer a multi-stage reliability chain connecting them back to the companion. The live alternative is that each denial answers a separate accusation and should not be causalized into one system.

changed_reading.before: Non-error is a broad character judgment.
changed_reading.after: Non-error is cross-checked calibration: what is taught, retained, inwardly registered, seen, and spoken remains mutually aligned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's split mapping lets one occurrence activate both direct seeing and narration of a report. Held without collapsing the roots, this revises the custody model into a perception-to-relation bridge: witnessed material becomes report while remaining recognizable across the transfer.

activation_trace.role: Failure to locate a thing supplies loss between encounter and report.
Carrying something along supplies continuity across the transfer.
The dominant mapped branch supplies direct visual or insightful encounter.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies narration of report or verse as a second live image.

structural_cues: Seeing recurs through 53:11-19 and later becomes something disputed, queried, and ultimately shown.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two mapped inventories for the same QAC root; I supply the arrow from witnessed perception to narrated report without claiming the mappings are interchangeable. The materially live alternative is to retain only the dominant sight sense and treat narration as form-distant noise.

changed_reading.before: The companion's claim concerns either seeing or telling.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the denial protects the handoff by which something seen becomes something faithfully related.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to dispute what is seen activates both sharp verbal contest and, through the non-dominant mapping, oscillation. The companion's course can therefore remain stable while the addressees generate turbulence around it; contest is relocated from the witness to the social field.

activation_trace.role: Course deviation is the instability denied of the companion.
Long association makes the addressees participants in, not neutral observers of, the contest.
Sharp disputation supplies the overt social pressure around the witness.
The non-dominant image of oscillation supplies turbulence as an exploratory spatial mechanism.

structural_cues: A second-person challenge follows the heart's non-falsification, shifting grammatical pressure from the witness to the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disputation and a split oscillation image; I infer that the argument swirls around a stable witness rather than proving his instability. The alternative is that the verse only condemns a particular debate and has no bearing on the opening relational noun.

changed_reading.before: Opposition is evidence that the companion's account is unstable.
changed_reading.after: The account may remain on course while instability is generated by the audience's disputing relation to what was seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent, an endpoint, enveloping cover, and the eye's refusal both to swerve and exceed form a bounded spatial encounter. The focus verbs now deny opposite calibration failures: missing the course and overrunning the limit into a destructive hollow.

activation_trace.role: Leaving the intended route supplies under-calibration or missed direction.
A hunter's destructive pit supplies the consequence of overrunning a safe boundary.
Descent and arrival supply controlled movement into the encounter.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the encounter's explicit boundary.
A covering above the object supplies perceptual pressure without implying loss of calibration.
Lateral drift of the eye supplies the missed-course failure explicitly denied.
Crossing a limit supplies the opposite failure of perceptual excess.

structural_cues: The encounter moves through descent, proximity, terminal location, covering, and a paired negative statement about gaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the spatial sequence and two denied gaze failures; I infer a corridor with both a route and a limit, then map its calibration back to ضل and غوى. A live alternative is that غوى remains wholly ethical and should not receive the pit-shaped spatial overlay.

changed_reading.before: The companion simply did not take a wrong turn.
changed_reading.after: He remained calibrated through an overwhelming encounter, neither missing its directed course nor exceeding its appointed bound.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invented designations lack compelling warrant, then conjecture and appetite are followed despite arriving guidance. This provides a concrete error pipeline: labels counterfeit a map, conjecture traces it, and desire supplies motive. The focus pair can now distinguish track-level ضلال from appetite-sustained غي.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from aim supplies the pipeline's route-level result.
Immersion in falsehood supplies the motivational and judgmental result.
A name as public designation supplies labels that can masquerade as a map.
Compelling proof supplies the warrant explicitly absent from those labels.
Tracing step after step supplies continued movement along the counterfeit map.
Uncertain supposition supplies the weak epistemic basis being followed.
Inclination of the self supplies motive that keeps conjecture attractive.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the available counter-route.

structural_cues: The ayah explicitly sequences naming, absent authority, following conjecture and appetite, and the prior arrival of guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each component and their grammatical sequence; I infer a causal pipeline from counterfeit naming through conjecture and appetite to deviation. A live alternative treats conjecture and appetite as parallel descriptions rather than successive causes.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies an unspecified error.
changed_reading.after: It denies the specific rival mechanism later exposed: the companion does not follow an invented map because conjecture and desire make it appealing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus root returns inside a contrast between straying from God's path and being guided, both held under superior knowledge. The opening denial therefore reads less like self-certification and more like a verdict whose criterion is a known path and whose knower exceeds the disputants.

activation_trace.role: The focus denial supplies the classification later reopened under an explicit criterion.
Audience familiarity remains local evidence but no longer the ultimate tribunal.
Disclosure to the true knower supplies the authority that classifies both routes.
Repeated deviation from guidance ties the later classification directly to the focus root.
An extended traversable path supplies the criterion from which straying is measured.
Gentle direction to the true path supplies the contrasting positive classification.

structural_cues: The same root ض ل ل recurs with an explicit source-path and a balanced contrast to guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root, path, contrast, and divine knowing; I infer that 53:30 retrospectively names the standard behind 53:2. The alternative is that 53:30 is a universal classification unrelated to the earlier defense of the companion.

changed_reading.before: The audience is asked to accept the companion's own denial of error.
changed_reading.after: Their long observation is invited as evidence, but the decisive classification belongs to the knower of who left His path and who accepted guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Non-transferable burden leads to purposeful striving, visible outcome, recompense, and completion without deficiency. That sequence turns the focus pair from abstract cognition into an accountable trajectory: course and result belong to the agent and cannot be borrowed from his companions.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies social proximity while leaving agency distinguishable.
Failure and ruined outcome supply the terminal condition denied of his trajectory.
A heavy burden supplies responsibility that remains attached to its bearer.
Work and earned action supply the agent's own contribution to the trajectory.
Purposeful motion toward a sought end supplies direction rather than static belief.
Corresponding recompense supplies an outcome matched to the action.
Full completion without deficiency closes the trajectory against loss.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from singular burden to singular striving, its disclosure, and fully corresponding recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies personal burden, movement, display, and full return; I infer that these make guidance a lived trajectory whose failure would be personally owned. The alternative is that this moral economy does not retroactively specify the companion's epistemic reliability.

changed_reading.before: Not straying is only having correct ideas.
changed_reading.after: Not straying is an owned course of action whose visible striving and eventual result do not terminate in failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destruction sequence combines a lethal waste or abyss, inversion, being hurled downward, and total covering. It reactivates the focus roots' hiddenness and hunter's-pit images, so the paired denial can faintly contrast the companion's preserved trajectory with communities whose false orientation becomes physical erasure.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance and burial supply the terminal erasure denied in the focus.
A hunter's pit as destruction supplies a latent endpoint of corrupt direction.
A lethal abyss or waste supplies catastrophic terrain.
Turning a thing away from its proper face supplies inversion before collapse.
Being cast downward supplies realized physical fall.
A covering that encompasses everything supplies final obliteration.

structural_cues: The later historical sequence moves from moral superlatives through overthrow to unspecified total covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destruction, inversion, fall, and covering; I infer these as the materialized terminus of lost orientation and map that terminus back to focus branch images. The alternative is that the historical judgments furnish no claim about the companion's destiny.

changed_reading.before: The negatives exclude only mistaken thought.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also deny a trajectory toward inversion, pitfall, and erasure of the kind later materialized in destroyed peoples.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning awakens caution, the event draws near, and no independent uncoverer can remove its cover. Against these cues, 'your companion' becomes the near, visible bearer of a warning that has not disappeared from access even though the warned event remains beyond human unveiling or removal.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness or disappearance supplies the access failure denied of the companion.
Close association supplies social nearness of the warning's bearer.
A warning that wakes caution supplies the companion's urgent function.
Approach and nearness intensify the cost of treating the bearer as inaccessible or lost.
Lifting a cover supplies the unavailable independent power over the approaching event.

structural_cues: Demonstrative warning, doubled nearness language, and exclusive negation compress the closing horizon before the audience is challenged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, nearness, and unavailable uncovering; I infer a distinction between an accessible human bearer and an event humans cannot unveil or avert. The alternative is that كاشفة means only removal of distress, leaving no disclosure contrast.

changed_reading.before: The companion is defended only against a past accusation.
changed_reading.after: He is also the presently near bearer of a warning that has not gone missing, precisely as its object becomes inescapably near.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close turns from self-important astonishment and heedless head-raising to lowered head and obedient worship. Because the opening calls the witness 'your companion,' the error question becomes relational: familiarity does not excuse the audience's posture, and the risk of misorientation shifts from the familiar speaker toward those refusing embodied response.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association makes rejection of the speaker a failure inside an existing relationship.
Wrongful collective alignment supplies a live social risk on the audience side.
Self-magnification supplies an inward posture beneath dismissive astonishment.
Persistence in diversion and heedlessness supplies collective nonresponse.
Raising the head supplies the embodied posture reversed by the next command.
Lowering and bowing the head supplies the demanded bodily reversal.
Humble obedience supplies the durable orientation meant to replace heedlessness.

structural_cues: The closing second-person plural sequence moves from affective dismissal to raised-head heedlessness and then imperative prostration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies audience postures and their commanded reversal; I infer that the opening possessive makes those postures a response to someone already known. The alternative is that the close addresses generic unbelief without relocating the opening charge of error.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks only whether the companion is correctly oriented.
changed_reading.after: It also prepares a reversal: the familiar companion is cleared, while the audience must decide whether familiarity will end in collective heedlessness or reoriented obedience.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the zootechnical غ و ي branch rather than the focus verb's ordinary guidance sense. It remains anchored in غَوَىٰ and gains context from gestation, upbringing, bodily interior, and generative fluid; render it only as a latent formation analogy, never as the lexical translation of 53:2.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins an ownerless-stray image, protective accompaniment, and a branch in which a young creature fails through too little or too much milk.

activation_trace.role: An ownerless domestic animal in a place of loss supplies separation from care.
Protective accompaniment supplies continued care.
A young creature harmed by deprivation or excess of milk supplies malformed intake.
Growth and upbringing supply a developmental frame.
The fetus hidden in the womb supplies a protected formative stage.
The interior of a body supplies the site of formation.
Clear generative fluid supplies the later material analogy for measured formation.

changed_reading.before: Error is only choosing a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, error can also be failed formation through abandonment or disordered intake, while the companion is presented as preserved and soundly formed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it carries the غ و ي inventory's endpoint branch into the verbal focus occurrence. It remains anchored by غَوَىٰ and is sharply activated by the later declaration of the true terminus; downstream prose should label it an endpoint overlay, not a grammatical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غَوَىٰ has an inventory branch for the farthest limit or endpoint, alongside the ordinary false-guidance branch.

activation_trace.role: Departure from aim supplies a route that fails before its proper terminus.
The farthest limit or endpoint supplies the possibility of terminating at the wrong horizon.
Lordship and mastery identify the owner of the true terminal direction.
The limit at which movement ends supplies the explicit true terminus.

changed_reading.before: The companion merely avoided wrong turns along the way.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he also did not install a terminal horizon short of the Lord to whom every course ends.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the raised-banner branch is nominal and remote from verbal غَوَىٰ. It remains packet-anchored and is activated by the opening prominent marker and later visible sign; render it as a visual countermark motif, not as a claim that the verb means 'raise a banner.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A غ و ي branch names a raised banner or sign, allowing the second negation to cast a faint shadow over false orientation markers.

activation_trace.role: Loss of direction creates the need for a trustworthy marker.
A raised banner or trader's sign supplies an exploratory orientation marker.
A prominent sign or item of knowledge supplies the opening true marker.
A visible sign supplies disclosed evidence against counterfeit marking.
Public naming supplies rival markers that possess designation without warrant.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and error are invisible interior states.
changed_reading.after: As a visual overlay, the companion neither loses the true marker nor substitutes a raised countermark made only of inherited names.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is unusual because it lets a protective branch of ص ح ب imply an enabling cause rather than merely describe social familiarity. It remains anchored in صَاحِبُكُمْ and receives contextual support from refuge and protection; prose should state the preservation arrow as an inference and keep ordinary companionship co-present.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The middle noun's inventory includes protective keeping expressed as accompaniment.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies a possible enabling condition for non-deviation.
The abandoned stray supplies the contrary condition from which accompaniment preserves.
Joining a gathering place that gives refuge supplies protected arrival.
Repelling harm through protection supplies explicit preservation elsewhere in the context.

changed_reading.before: The companion avoids error solely through autonomous competence.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading hears non-deviation as preserved accompaniment: he is kept with, not abandoned to, the conditions of straying.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the reciprocal collective branch of غ و ي is applied to a singular verb through the social pressure around صَاحِبُكُمْ. It remains anchored by both focus words and gains context from patterned following and collective heedlessness; render it as a social activation, not as singular-verb morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus keeps the subject socially 'yours' while denying a root whose inventory includes gathering together in wrongful hostility.

activation_trace.role: Close association supplies belonging without requiring ideological conformity.
Collective cooperation in wrong supplies the social capture being exploratorily denied.
Loyal succession and repeated following supply formation of a shared pattern.
A human collective supplies the scale at which a corrupt pattern can become communal.
Collective persistence in heedless diversion supplies the closing instance of group posture.

changed_reading.before: Calling him 'your companion' either assimilates him to the audience or severs him from them.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can hold both relation and resistance: he remains theirs socially while refusing capture by a collectively reinforced wrong.

strongest_changes: The paired negatives separate route loss from corrupt orientation instead of functioning as synonyms.
Speech, excluded appetite, and hidden imparting turn the focus into a source-to-utterance integrity claim.
Teaching, heart, sight, and bounded gaze reconstruct non-error as a calibrated witness chain.
Invented names, conjecture, appetite, and arrived guidance expose a rival mechanism that the companion does not follow.
The closing raised-head versus bowed-head reversal relocates the practical risk of misorientation toward the familiar audience.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah remained simultaneously biographical, spatial, epistemic, transmissive, social, and outcome-oriented. Especially productive were the repeated paired-negation form, the split seeing/narration mapping, and remote but anchored images of nourishment, pitfall, banner, endpoint, and protective accompaniment; none needs to displace the others.
remaining_uncertainties: The custody model supplies an implicit carried object that the focus syntax itself does not name.
The seeing-to-narration bridge depends on retaining a non-dominant split mapping without equating its roots.
Nourishment, banner, endpoint, and collective-capture readings are branch-distant overlays and should not be rendered as direct lexical senses of غَوَىٰ.
Protective accompaniment may be causal preservation or only a secondary resonance of ordinary audience familiarity.
Several context sequences support causal arrows, but they can also remain parallel rebuttals rather than one integrated mechanism.
